## Key Concepts

### Transformer-Based Models
Artificial intelligence models that have enabled automated systems capable of analyzing scientific literature.

### Natural Language Processing (NLP)
The process by which computers can understand and interpret human language, enabling them to analyze and extract information from unstructured text.

### Research Paper Analysis
The task of evaluating and summarizing large numbers of research papers, often time-consuming and inefficient for manual review.

### Literature Review
A method of identifying relevant studies, evaluating findings, and synthesizing information from numerous sources in academic disciplines.

### AI-Assisted Literature Review Systems
Automated tools that use machine learning algorithms to support researchers in managing large collections of research documents and improving literature analysis.
